_comment: MoOS theme-family palettes. Each palette drives the SAME UI2 engine (SVGs, aurorae, QML) recoloured to its identity — one design system, many MoOS looks. Roles match artwork/moos-ui2/palette.json exactly so the shared generator logic applies. Graphite (dark) and Tidal (light) live in palette.json and stay the base; these are the added members of the family. All designed for high contrast (text-on-canvas >= 14:1) and a distinct, modern 2026 identity.

nova._identity: Cosmic deep-navy with a cyan->blue->violet aurora. MoOS's original Nova spirit, reborn on the UI2 engine.

amethyst._identity: Warm aubergine with orchid + amber glow. Calm, premium, the UI1 warmth carried forward.

midnight._identity: True-black OLED. Maximum contrast, minimal energy, a single crisp cyan accent.

aurora._identity: The merged Breeze+Nova: a clean slate base with a teal->blue northern-lights sweep. Modern, crisp, fresh.

_extras._comment: Per-theme EXTRAS mirror the UI2 EXTRAS roles (deep semantic tints for chips/badges, and selected_text = the ink drawn ON an accent highlight — dark on these dark themes).
